tools.name: github
tools.description: Run GitHub CLI (gh) using the GitHub account connected in Settings → Third-party accounts. Supply argv without the gh executable. Requests run directly from the execution machine. Each invocation starts a fresh process. Nothing is retried automatically; inspect prior effects before repeating a write. Use exec_command with credentials for git push or other shell workflows.

tools.name: github_read_notifications
tools.description: Read one page of the connected GitHub account notification feed, independently of realtime filters and checkpoints. GET only; never marks read or changes subscriptions. all=true includes read notifications; participating=true restricts to participating/mention notifications according to GitHub. Defaults: unread, account feed, 30 rows. since/before are ISO timestamps. Local whitelist filters are AND across fields, OR within each list; omitted fields allow all (omit unrestricted fields rather than passing null), empty arrays match none. thread IDs are notification IDs, not issue/PR numbers. A filtered page can be empty and still have next_page. GitHub reason is a thread-level reason and mention may persist on later comments; no direct-reply inference. No comment/body expansion.
